skills.name: cloud-fleet
skills.description: How to run fleets of cloudy-cloud subagents (Instabox cloud machines that push cloudy-cloud/<id> branches to GitHub) and keep the output manageable. Use when starting many cloud_agent workers, fanning out a swarm, using coordinators or sub-coordinators, merging many worker branches into one trunk, or avoiding a flood of PRs.

skills.name: cloudy-cloud-setup
skills.description: Sets up Cloudy Cloud, which runs coding-agent subagents (Claude Code, pi, oh-my-pi, Codex or opencode) on cloud machines. Use when the user says "set up Cloudy Cloud", "install cloudy cloud", "cloudycloud setup", or asks how to get cloudy-cloud working.
